name: shallow fruit basket
caption: A shallow fruit basket with a low rim, a wide cavity and an arched carrying handle. Continuous woven walls enclose a cavity; both arched handle ends join the rim. Oval walls keep an even thickness and the handle arch stays continuous. Overall width is 1.55 times depth; height is 0.28 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous tan, dark brown, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
